verdict.rationale: Brex says it lets teams issue vendor-specific cards with per-transaction limits and procurement approval flows. Its developer docs show virtual cards being issued programmatically through the Team API and Pipedream, including purpose-scoped cards such as a WFH stipend card whose limit resets monthly. One community comment praising the 'dynamic credit card generator' lightly corroborates this. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of ad-spend or merchant-category scoping, evidence that issuance is instant, and in-depth first-party docs or hands-on reports on card restriction controls.
